'''Monor II''',<ref name="CSWE-Monor II">{{CSWECite|II|328|Monor II}}</ref> also called '''Kline Colony''',<ref name="CSWE-Kline Colony">{{CSWECite|II|222|Kline Colony}}</ref> was the [[Sunesi]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. It was ruled by a monarchy of [[Priest-Prince|priest-princes]]. The tenth, [[Agapos the Tenth]], ascended in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]]. This [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was where the mysterious [[Nom Anor]] infected various [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] diplomats and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] with [[coomb spore]]s, [[Death/Legends|killing]] many of them.
